Backup existing regular files: /etc/app/config with spaces, /etc/it's.conf
New files (must not exist; deleted on failure): /etc/app/new.conf
Backup directories as tar (replaced on failure): /etc/nginx/conf.d, /srv
Apply:
printf 'x' > /etc/app/new.conf; systemctl reload app
Verify:
test -s /etc/app/new.conf
On failure: restore every backup, then run:
systemctl reload app
Reason: golden
